note: FAKE preliminary data for the demo landing page. Not a baseline and not a gate result.

verdicts.caption: This is the single decision for every task together: whether the new agent is close enough to the current one.

pass.caption: The new agent was close enough to the current one that this test says go ahead.

block.caption: The new agent was clearly worse than the current one, so this test says stop.

insufficient_evidence.caption: This test cannot yet tell whether the new agent is close enough, so it is not a yes or a no.

invalid_run.caption: The test run itself was not reliable, so this result should not be used to decide.

overall.note: FAKE. Scored rollouts, leaving out the scenario with no pass rates, pool to baseline 13 passes out of 15 counted and candidate 12 passes out of 15 counted. The 90% interval crosses -delta, so the suite gate is not pass or block.

diagnostics.note: FAKE diagnostic. Not a gate verdict. Baseline 4 passes out of 5 counted, candidate 4 passes out of 5 counted.
FAKE diagnostic. The suite gate above is the only verdict. Baseline 4 passes out of 5 counted, candidate 3 passes out of 5 counted.
FAKE diagnostic with no pass rates. One candidate cassette miss. The document miss rate is exactly 1/20, which is not over 5%.
FAKE diagnostic. 5 passes out of 5 counted on each arm. Scheduled count equals rollouts_per_scenario on both arms.

aa.caption: Running the current agent against itself should almost never say stop, which shows the test does not cry wolf, and this check is coming soon.
aa.note: A/A summary is not in this file. coverage is the Week 4 fraction of resamples whose 90% CI covers 0.

mde.caption: This is the smallest drop in success rate the test can reliably catch with the number of tries in this budget, and more tries make that drop smaller.

undetectable.caption: A smaller drop than that comes back as not enough evidence, not as a stop.
